def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    run_lengths = []
    count = 1
    for i in range(len(s) - 1):
        if s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            count += 1
        else:
            run_lengths.append(count)
            count = 1
    run_lengths.append(count)
    insert = sum(1 for length in run_lengths if length % 2 == 0)
    print(insert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
